title: David Choe Got Lost Looking for a Dinosaur in the Congo
description: Choe tells the extended story of entering the Congo to look for a reported dinosaur, moving from *Thumbs Up* and early Vice history through jungle scale, dwindling food, conflict with companions and the impossibility of controlling the forest.
